lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := r.wf.2.1
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    case' inl =>
      rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, s, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
  case' tapp der sub ih =>
    have := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, s, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    have := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨s, red⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih => rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨s, red⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first
  | left; solve_by_elim [Value.abs, Value.tabs, Value.inl, Value.inr]
  | right
    exact ⟨_, by solve_by_elim [Value.lc, Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.tapp,
      Red.let_body, Red.let_bind, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]⟩

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    have := r.wf.2.1
    have := ih_l rfl l
    have := ih_r rfl r
  case' tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    have := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    have := ih rfl der
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    have := (body_let.mp lc).2
    cases ih rfl der
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih => cases ih rfl der
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first
  | left; constructor; assumption
  | aesop (config := { enableSimp := false }) (add safe [apply Value.lc, forward canonical_form_abs, forward canonical_form_tabs], 50% constructors Red)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases lc
    have := ih_l rfl l
    have := ih_r rfl r
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    right
    cases lc
    have := ih rfl der
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases lc
    cases ih rfl der
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih => cases ih rfl der
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first
  | left; constructor; assumption
  | aesop (config := { enableSimp := false }) (add norm unfold body, safe [forward canonical_form_abs, forward canonical_form_tabs], 50% constructors Red)

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq

  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := ih_l rfl l
    have := ih_r rfl r
  case' tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first

  | right; have h := lc; cases h

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' let' => have := (body_let.mp lc).2
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := ih_l rfl l
    have := ih_r rfl r
  case' tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first
  | left; constructor; assumption
  | right; cases lc
    aesop (config := { enableSimp := false })
      (add safe [forward canonical_form_abs, forward canonical_form_tabs],
        50% constructors Red)

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' let' => have := (body_let.mp lc).2
  case' case => have := (body_case.mp lc).2
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1
    have := ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1
  case' tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih |

    cases ih rfl der.wf.2.1
  case' case.inl val =>

  all_goals first
  | left; constructor; assumption
  | right; cases lc
    aesop (config := { enableSimp := false })

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1
    have := ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1
  case' tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih |
      case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases ih rfl der.wf.2.1
  case' case.inl val =>
    obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first
  | left; constructor; assumption
  | right; cases lc
    aesop (config := { enableSimp := false })
      (add norm unfold body, safe [forward canonical_form_abs, forward canonical_form_tabs],
        50% constructors Red)
